page.overview:
Who is Usagi Alohaoe?

Alison Alohaoe (Mother) Tory Alohaoe (younger Sister)}} Usagi Alohaoe (ウサギ・アロハオエ Usagi Arohaoe) is one of Jodio Joestar's core allies in JoJo's Bizarre Adventure's ninth part, The JOJOLands.

He was first introduced as a student buying drugs from Jodio, with the help of Paco Laburantes. He later is revealed to be the fourth member of Meryl Mei Qi's heist crew, setting out to steal a 24-carat blue diamond. His Stand is THE MATTEKUDASAI.

Usagi is a slender youth with a well-defined physique and dons a snug dark suit that covers most of his body, except for his extremities and face. His hooded suit reveals his light-colored bangs, while its tightness indicates that he has a conventional hairstyle with a few spikes at the front. The suit's midsection is darker and features circular emblems on the shoulders, which previously depicted legs with garter belts but are now flipped upside down to resemble his Stand's extended arms.

He pairs his suit with striped shorts and carries a lightweight backpack. In later appearances, Usagi sports a light beret. He also wears eyeliner.
